_comment: Reference schema for the Evergreen Backlog Notion database. The pipeline reads from this to know property names. If your database differs, update the property names in scripts/notion_upload.py and the SKILL.md template.
_card_rendering: See style/notion-card-rendering.md for cover-image rotation and quote-rendering rules. Every page gets a random cover from cover_image_recommendations below; verbatim quotes use paragraph blocks with straight ASCII quotes, never the quote block type.

Video Title.description: Sub-item title; mirror as Typefully draft_title

Source URL.description: Same as Video URL by default; can differ if source is non-YouTube

Status.description: Initialize as 'Adding Media'; advance to 'Ready to Post' after both Notion + Typefully attaches succeed

Parent item.description: Self-relation to the parent video page (the source). Each video gets one parent + many sub-items (one per extracted post)

Clip Start.description: Verbatim opening phrase of the video clip (not a timestamp). The video editor uses this to locate the cut.

Clip End.description: Verbatim closing phrase of the video clip

Key Quote.description: The single sharpest quote in the post; used for snippet previews

Typefully Shared URL.description: Public share URL of the Typefully draft

Typefully Draft ID.description: Numeric Typefully draft ID for API access

page_body_template: ## Post draft (Goku long-form, Ready to Post)
<after upload: native video block, attached via File Upload API>
